texts.bulletin: Harvest disruption risk in Dupax del Norte due to rainfall of 22.0 mm/24h. Farmers in ripening or harvesting stages should: (1) Defer combine harvester deployment to avoid bogging; (2) Protect cut stalks from further wetting; (3) Prioritize mechanical drying over sun-drying for collected grain. Postharvest drying risk is ELEVATED. Coordinate with DA mechanization service providers for mobile dryer access.
texts.sms: DA ADVISORY: Rain risk for harvest in Dupax del Norte. Defer harvest, use mechanical dryer if available. Call MAO for help.
texts.lgu:
HARVEST ADVISORY — Dupax del Norte
Rainfall of 22.0 mm may disrupt ongoing harvest operations.
Recommended actions:
1. Advise farmers to assess field conditions before deploying machinery.
2. Coordinate with RCEF mechanization pool for mobile dryer deployment.
3. Issue tarpaulin assistance where needed.
4. Document areas where harvest was deferred for scheduling follow-up.
texts.facebook:

📞 Contact your Municipal Agriculturist for drying support.
#Palay #Mais #Harvest #DARFOCagayanValley

texts.bulletin: OPERATIONS ADVISORY - DEFER OPEN-AIR GRAIN DRYING - Ivana: sun-drying of palay or corn grain should be deferred. Basis: rainfall increases runoff, wash-off, grain wetting, or harvest loss risk; high humidity slows drying and increases mold or grain-quality risk; recent rain makes open-air drying unreliable. ACAP calendar anchor: Jul 16-31 - no active rice/corn stage. Recommended action: avoid open sun-drying; use covered temporary storage or mechanical drying where available.

texts.bulletin: Harvest disruption risk in Mahatao due to rainfall of 20.9 mm/24h. Farmers in ripening or harvesting stages should: (1) Defer combine harvester deployment to avoid bogging; (2) Protect cut stalks from further wetting; (3) Prioritize mechanical drying over sun-drying for collected grain. Postharvest drying risk is ELEVATED. Coordinate with DA mechanization service providers for mobile dryer access.
texts.sms: DA ADVISORY: Rain risk for harvest in Mahatao. Defer harvest, use mechanical dryer if available. Call MAO for help.
texts.lgu:
HARVEST ADVISORY — Mahatao
Rainfall of 20.9 mm may disrupt ongoing harvest operations.
Recommended actions:
1. Advise farmers to assess field conditions before deploying machinery.
2. Coordinate with RCEF mechanization pool for mobile dryer deployment.
3. Issue tarpaulin assistance where needed.
4. Document areas where harvest was deferred for scheduling follow-up.
